title: Align task-sync documentation with the shared code review source identity
outcome: Remove obsolete references to a separate code review freeze from the task-sync specification and design brief while keeping the distinction between code source identity and imported planning freshness.
acceptance: docs/spec.md and docs/features/git-task-sync.md describe HEAD and tracked task bytes through the shared code source_id and state that data commits never establish tested code.
The wording adds no hashing, source capture or Git or review authority.
